queer_characters.name: Sean Dalmazo
queer_characters.notes: HIV-positive gay man and veteran ACT UP Paris activist; his illness and death are central to a film depicting the real-life AIDS crisis and activist response, framing his death within historical activism rather than gratuitous tragedy.

queer_characters.notes: HIV-negative gay man who forms a loving emotional and sexual relationship with Sean; portrayed as a full character within the activist community.
